snippet.title: PARADISE FALLS | Live-Action Reveal Trailer - WISHLIST NOW!
snippet.description:
Wishlist PARADISE FALLS on Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4125050/Paradise_Falls/?beta=0

It's Not Just a Game, It's an Obsession.

Meet Dennis. He's got a missing daughter, a massive secret, and a very unhealthy relationship with a kitchen knife. Join his descent in this live-action trailer that blends the real world with the terrifying pixel art landscape of Paradise Falls.

This trailer is 100% for the fans and to celebrate the opening of our Steam store page! (Yes, the spooky pixel art game footage is real and comes at the end!)

The Game: Psychological Point-and-Click Horror
Paradise Falls is a deep, unnerving adventure game where the biggest enemy isn't the monsters—it's your own mind. We're using the classic AGS engine to bring back that old-school adventure dread with a modern psychological twist.

Why You Need to Wishlist:
The only way to escape the constant hallucinations of gore and guilt is to clean the knife. The game tracks your anxiety, and the environment changes based on your mental state. If you love classic titles like Silent Hill and dark, narrative-driven point-and-clicks, this one is for you.

Platform: PC (Windows)

Engine: Powered by the legendary Adventure Game Studio (AGS)

Trailer Note: Live-action footage is for entertainment purposes only!

Let us know what you think of the trailer in the comments! 👇
